\begin{abstract}
We introduce \sys, which improves accuracy by 12\% on CASP14. Code: \url{https://example.org/foldnet}.
\end{abstract}

\section{Introduction}\label{sec:intro}
Structure prediction~\cite{jumper2021,baek2021} is hard. Following \citet{jumper2021}, \sys minimises the
loss in Eq.~\eqref{eq:loss} over $x \in \R^n$ with $\norm{x} \le 1$\footnote{The unit ball, \eg in $\R^3$.}.
Schr\"odinger, Erd\H{o}s and Poincar\'e are cited ``often'' --- see \href{https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762}{this paper}.
Section~\ref{sec:method} has the details, Table~\ref{tab:results} the numbers and Figure~\ref{fig:arch} the model.

\section{Method}\label{sec:method}
\subsection*{Objective}
We solve
\begin{equation}\label{eq:loss}
  \theta^\star = \argmin_{\theta} \sum_{i=1}^{n} \norm{f_\theta(x_i) - y_i}^2 .
\end{equation}
The update is
\begin{align}
  g_t &= \nabla_\theta \mathcal{L}(\theta_t), \label{eq:grad} \\
  \theta_{t+1} &= \theta_t - \eta g_t . \nonumber
\end{align}
\begin{theorem}[Convergence]\label{thm:conv}
If $\eta$ is small, \eqref{eq:grad} converges.
\end{theorem}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Encoder with $d = 512$.
  \item Decoder:
  \begin{enumerate}
    \item attention,
    \item refinement.
  \end{enumerate}
\end{itemize}
